name: T2 sort products by price
precondition: standard_user is logged in and on the inventory page (/inventory.html). The sort dropdown has its default option, 'Name (A to Z)'. The page shows 6 products.
steps: Note the names of the products on the page.
Select 'Price (low to high)' in the sort dropdown.
expected_results: The selected option of the sort dropdown is 'Price (low to high)'.
The displayed prices, read as numeric amounts, are in non-decreasing order: each price is less than or equal to the next.
The product list still contains 6 products.
The set of product names is the same as the names noted in step 1.
